label: Qatiq
note: Boiled milk fermented 6-10 h in a warm place; denser than ayran; strained gives suzma, dried suzma is kurut; used in the Uzbek chalop soup

about.text: A fermented milk of the Turkic countries and Bulgaria, a more solid yoghurt than ayran, made from boiled milk left warm for 6-10 hours.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Denser than ayran. Strained, it gives suzma, and dried suzma is kurut; it is also used in the Uzbek chalop soup. The sources do not name the cultures.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

processing.text: Boiled milk set in a warm place; the sources do not name the cultures. It keeps 2-3 days cool, then turns very sour.
